material.description: scripts/dev/serve.mjs:22-23 PORT=8790, HOST fixed; stage.sh copies (cp -r) the tree so the served .dev-site goes stale after every edit (see oscraft-dev-site-serves-pre-edit-minimap-js). Acceptance: --port/PORT env with port 0 default printing the URL, and the server serves live source via a layered root (js/client and scenarios straight from the working tree, pkg from the staged dir) so no restage is needed. Witness: two servers up at once, each reflecting an edit within one second.
